description: Na₃YNbSi₂PO₁₂ is Pb (Zr_0.50 Ti_0.48) O_3-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.54-2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.93 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.83 Å. Y is bonded to six O atoms to form YO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.30 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.23 Å. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-41°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.73 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 26-38°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.58-1.70 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent YO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 15-45°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.61 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Y, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Y, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₃YSi trigonal bipyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Y, and one Si atom to form distorted face-sharing ONa₂YSi trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Nb, and one Si atom.
